title: The normalized completion Roos triangle under completed coefficient transport
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, and a scheme W. Let c:R^pbc_(E,W) ≅ R_(E,W) be an isomorphism of completed commutative coefficient ring sheaves whose Ring image is integralDetailedCoefficientComparison [lem-weil-pbc-integral-stratified-perfect-characterization]. Write F for derived restriction along c inverse [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], C for the actual reflection onto intrinsically complete objects, and η:Id→C for its unit [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-adjunction]. For every derived object K, the products of the intrinsic derived reductions R_n(FK) exist [def-weil-derived-complete]. There are p:F(CK)→∏_n R_n(FK) and δ:∏_n R_n(FK)→F(CK)[1] giving the distinguished Roos triangle with second arrow one minus the canonical reduction transition. They satisfy F(η_K) followed by p = the product of the canonical derived reduction units of FK. No completeness, constructibility or boundedness is assumed on K.

source.place: Step 1, completion coefficient comparison; Stacks Tags 099M, 099N(2),(5), 06YY and Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.5.2.

proof.text: Use the normalized finite projections of the coefficient comparison to identify quotient extension after inverse coefficient restriction with intrinsic derived reduction. Apply the tensor/restriction adjunction on K-flat representatives. The comparison takes pure tensors to the same tensors with transported coefficients, so it identifies both the transition maps and the quotient-unit augmentations. Descend through the universal derived scalar counits to an isomorphism of augmented reduction sequences.

Apply the normalized completed Koszul quotient comparison and the completed Koszul reduction Roos triangle to a representative. The resulting completion is the Koszul reflection. Uniqueness of a left adjoint to the intrinsic-complete inclusion identifies this reflection with the actual completion, and the comparison preserves its unit.

Inverse restriction along the coefficient isomorphism is an exact equivalence and preserves products. Transport the distinguished triangle through it, through the preceding augmented sequence isomorphism and through the unit-compatible comparison of completion objects. The coordinate unit equations combine into the displayed product-unit equation by product extensionality. No completeness or geometric boundedness of the input is used.

proof_origin.place: Section Derived completion in the constant Noetherian case, lemma-naive-completion (099M), its Koszul reconstruction proof, and lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case (099N). Normalize all comparisons by the quotient units.

lean.statement:
theorem completedCoefficientCompletionRoosTransport
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (W : Scheme.{u})
    (c : pbcAdicCompletion W (pbcIntegralDatum l E) ≅
      completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E W)
    (_hc : (adicLisseForget W).mapIso c = integralDetailedCoefficientComparison W l E)
    (K : PbcCompletedDerived W (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    ∃ hp : HasProduct (fun n : ℕ ↦ (sfDerivedReductionRestricted l E W n).obj
        ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj K)),
      letI := hp
      ∃ (p : (pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj
          ((pbcActualCompletion (pbcIntegralDatum l E) W).obj K) ⟶
          ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ (sfDerivedReductionRestricted l E W n).obj
            ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj K))
        (δ : (∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ ↦ (sfDerivedReductionRestricted l E W n).obj
            ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj K)) ⟶
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj
            ((pbcActualCompletion (pbcIntegralDatum l E) W).obj K))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
        IsDerivedLimitTriangle
          (fun n ↦ (sfDerivedReductionTransition l E W n).app
            ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj K))
          ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj
            ((pbcActualCompletion (pbcIntegralDatum l E) W).obj K)) p δ ∧
        (pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).map
            ((pbcActualCompletionUnit (pbcIntegralDatum l E) W).app K) ≫ p =
          Pi.lift (fun n ↦ (sfDerivedReductionUnit l E W n).app
            ((pbcDerivedRestrict c.inv).obj K))
